matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 100th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this week: we're staring down a statistical mirage that's almost too good to be true. Our pass offense is operating in another dimension entirely—100th percentile territory—going up against a Steelers secondary that grades out at a merely mortal 71st percentile, which is the kind of edge you circle on the calendar and dream about. The problem is that recent form suggests Pittsburgh isn't going away quietly (net EPA of 0.02 over their last three games shows they're tighter than the betting line implies), and our recent head-to-head record against them is decidedly mixed. Still, with Drake Maye at the helm and a home opener at Gillette with this kind of structural advantage in the passing game, this feels like the moment where elite talent meets optimal circumstances—assuming we can actually execute on what the tape tells us we should be able to do.
